screening_budget.notes: Candidates crossing either laptop screening limit are stopped after one completed task.

potion-code-16m-v2.reason: Highest nDCG@10, MRR@10, and recall@20 of the candidates with a complete screening matrix, with the smallest model download. It builds vectors more slowly and uses more memory than static-retrieval-v1. Promoted to the full public matrix.

static-retrieval-v1.reason: Default through v1.2.16. Scores slightly lower than potion-code-16m-v2 on the same screening matrix and needs a model download almost four times larger; it builds vectors faster and uses less memory. Still available as an opt-in profile (IVYGREP_MODEL_PROFILE=static).

general.reason: Crossed both laptop screening limits on its first completed task.

code-minilm-l6-v1.reason: Crossed both laptop screening limits on its first completed task; the partial quality result is a single-task result.

code-minilm-l12-v1.reason: Stopped after one task because it exceeded both screening budgets, with the longest vector build of the candidates. Its single-task nDCG@10 is the highest of the transformer candidates and below potion-code-16m-v2 on the same task.

nomic-ai/CodeRankEmbed.reason: Custom NomicBERT architecture is not supported by the portable local inference backend.

Salesforce/SFR-Embedding-Code-400M_R.reason: Non-commercial license and custom architecture are incompatible with the shipped default.

jinaai/jina-code-embeddings-1.5b.reason: The 1.5B-parameter custom model exceeds portable laptop download, memory, and inference budgets.
